title: Which way does the sea breeze blow?
question: On a sunny day, which way does the wind blow?
steps: Press and hold the sun in the sky to warm the coast. Let go and it cools.
Watch the thermometers on the sand and in the sea, the wind arrows and the pinwheel.
Use the button at the bottom left to switch between day and night.
observe: When the sun shines, the land warms up faster than the sea, so the wind blows from the sea to the land (a sea breeze). At night the land cools down faster than the sea, so the wind blows from the land to the sea (a land breeze). The bigger the difference between the land and the sea, the stronger the wind.

terms.name: Sea breeze
terms.description: The wind that blows from the sea toward the land in the daytime.

terms.name: Land breeze
terms.description: The wind that blows from the land toward the sea at night.

terms.name: Temperature
terms.description: How warm or cold something is. A thermometer measures it.

law.title: Sea breezes and land breezes
law.description: Land warms up and cools down faster than the sea. When the air over the warm side rises, air from the cool side moves in to take its place, and that is the wind. So in the daytime it blows from the sea to the land (a sea breeze), and at night from the land to the sea (a land breeze).

tip: Press and hold the sun: it shines on the coast and warms the land and the sea. The land warms up much faster. Let go and the land cools again. At night there is no sun, so the land cools by itself.
tip_short: Hold the sun to warm the coast

stages.text: Hold the sun and turn the pinwheel with a sea breeze!
stages.say: When the land gets warmer than the sea, the cool air over the sea blows toward the land. It blows from the sea, so we call it a **sea breeze**.
stages.miss: Keep pressing so the land warms up!

stages.text: Send the fishing boat out to sea on the night wind!
stages.say: At night the land cools down before the sea. Now the land is cooler, so the wind blows from the land to the sea. It blows from the land, so we call it a **land breeze**. Fishermen ride this night wind out to sea.
stages.miss: Wait for the land to cool down!

stages.text: Bring in the sailboat with the piece on a strong sea breeze!
stages.say: The bigger the difference between the land and the sea, the stronger the wind. Make the land hotter and the wind gets stronger too.
stages.win: The sailboat is here! A piece!

story.clue: There's a sailboat way out there! Huh? It's carrying a piece!

more.text: The wind has to blow toward the shore to bring the boat back.
